criteria.evidence: web/tests/e2e/service-pages.spec.ts reproduces the §8 state rows of not-found.md, error.md and offline.md in Chromium: 404 answered with HTTP 404 and noindex, the where-to-go zone capped at three small cards, the broken-link form in its sent and rate-limited states, the 500 page with its request id, copy confirmation and contact link, and the offline page with an empty cache, a saved page read from Cache Storage, a missing Cache Storage, a requested address that is not cached and the return to the requested address. Green in CI run 35548580714 (browser job 157 passed / 9 skipped). One row — the offline retry indicator — is covered by web/tests/service-pages.nuxt.test.ts instead: it lives only until the navigation starts, so Playwright cannot observe it.

The same browser suite asserts that the 404 page carries neither a copy field nor the request-code label, and that the 500 page shows the request id in the copy field and in the contact link. The unit test on serviceRequestId adds the source-level guarantee: on a 404 the value is not computed at all, so it never reaches the page payload (journal §28.4).
